name: dprint
description: Skill that checks for a minimum dprint version and, after confirmation, installs or updates dprint at user level; a session-start mod warns with a toast when a project has a dprint config but dprint is not installed.

warn_missing_dprint.title: Warn when dprint is missing
warn_missing_dprint.description: At interactive session start, shows a toast when the working directory (or its .config subdirectory) holds a dprint config (dprint.json, dprint.jsonc, .dprint.json, .dprint.jsonc) but no dprint binary is found on PATH or at ~/.dprint/bin/dprint. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it -- the toast creates no file or state. Default: true.
